data.description: A gearsman's nanites heal it of damage at the rate of a number of hit points per hour equal to its Hit Dice. Up to once per day, as a full-round action, it can heal any robot it touches of 4d6 points of damage-if a gearsman uses this ability on itself, it automatically heals the maximum amount.
data.name: Self-Repair
